title: How a Godly Man Talks to Customer Service When He's Furious
caption:
Nobody's grading the phone call. That's exactly why it matters.

A company wastes your afternoon and lies about the refund. You've got every right to be frustrated. But the guy on the other end of the line is reading a script somebody else wrote him, and how you talk to him when nothing's on the line is the truest read on who you actually are.

Church, the small group, the hold line. Same guy, or he isn't finished yet.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #selfcontrol
